AccountDetailsResponse.title: AccountDetailsResponse
AccountDetailsResponse.description: An account as its owner reads it: credentials are only declared present, never returned (R0.2.3).

AccountScope.title: AccountScope
AccountScope.description: Which rows of an account to read: those of no flow only, or all of them, of every flow and of none.

AccountStateResponse.title: AccountStateResponse
AccountStateResponse.description: The state of an account read from the exchange at the request (R0.2.2): the same body from worker and API.

AccountSummaryResponse.title: AccountSummaryResponse
AccountSummaryResponse.description:
An account in the list of its owner (R2.2.1, ADR 0126): network and capital its flows hold, never the balance,
which the exchange gives at /accounts/{id}/state.

ClosedPositionPageResponse.title: ClosedPositionPageResponse
ClosedPositionPageResponse.description: A page of the closed positions of a flow, from the most recent close (R1.7.2, R2.2.5).

ClosedPositionResponse.title: ClosedPositionResponse
ClosedPositionResponse.description: A closed position of a flow with its result (R1.7.2); amounts as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0018).

ConfigurationResponse.title: ConfigurationResponse
ConfigurationResponse.description: One configuration version of a flow.

CycleDetailResponse.title: CycleDetailResponse
CycleDetailResponse.description: A cycle with everything recorded about it (R1.7.1).

CycleSummaryResponse.title: CycleSummaryResponse
CycleSummaryResponse.description: A cycle in the list: its instants, its outcome and the decisions of the agent (R1.7.3).

DraftAssignmentRequest.title: DraftAssignmentRequest
DraftAssignmentRequest.description: Account, capital and assets of a draft; missing assets arrive empty, so the domain answers with the reason.

EquityPointResponse.title: EquityPointResponse
EquityPointResponse.description:
A point of the curve: its equity and how much it moved from the first point of the period, in percent with two
decimals, null when the first point has no equity (ADR 0137).

FlowCreationRequest.title: FlowCreationRequest
FlowCreationRequest.description: A missing name, model, asset or risk limit arrives empty, so the domain answers with the reason (R1.1.1).

FlowEquityResponse.title: FlowEquityResponse
FlowEquityResponse.description:
The equity curve of a flow: a point for each cycle, from the oldest, and the capital it is judged against
(R2.2.3); amounts as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0018).

FlowModificationRequest.title: FlowModificationRequest
FlowModificationRequest.description: Only the parts the user changes; the others keep the version in force (R1.1.3).

FlowOverviewResponse.title: FlowOverviewResponse
FlowOverviewResponse.description:
A flow in use with its last cycle, the next planned one, the outcomes of its last ten cycles from the most
recent and how its capital is doing (R1.7.3, R2.2.2, ADR 0127).

FlowPositionResponse.title: FlowPositionResponse
FlowPositionResponse.description: An open position of the flow (R1.6.1, R2.2.4); the percent is absent for a position without margin.

FlowRankingResponse.title: FlowRankingResponse
FlowRankingResponse.description:
A row of the ranking of the flows (R2.4.2): amounts as text (ADR 0018), percentages with two decimals, null
when not available (ADR 0135).

FlowResponse.title: FlowResponse
FlowResponse.description: A flow with the configuration version in force; a draft may have no account, capital or assets (ADR 0124).

FlowStateResponse.title: FlowStateResponse
FlowStateResponse.description: The state of a flow attributed from the exchange at the request (R1.6.1); amounts as strings (ADR 0018).

FlowStatisticsResponse.title: FlowStatisticsResponse
FlowStatisticsResponse.description:
The statistics of a flow over a period (R2.2.6): amounts as text (ADR 0018), win rate in percent with two
decimals, null when nothing is available (ADR 0122).

HistoryClosedPositionResponse.title: HistoryClosedPositionResponse
HistoryClosedPositionResponse.description: A closed position of the history, with its flow (R2.5.1).

HistoryClosedPositionsPageResponse.title: HistoryClosedPositionsPageResponse
HistoryClosedPositionsPageResponse.description: At most 50 closed positions, newest close first; `next` is the `after` of the following page.

HistoryCycleResponse.title: HistoryCycleResponse
HistoryCycleResponse.description: A cycle of the history, with its flow and the configuration version in force when it ran (R2.5.1).

HistoryCyclesPageResponse.title: HistoryCyclesPageResponse
HistoryCyclesPageResponse.description: At most 50 cycles, newest first; `next` is the `after` of the following page, null on the last one.

HistoryOrderResponse.title: HistoryOrderResponse
HistoryOrderResponse.description: An order of the history with its outcome and its executions; `flow` is null for an order of no flow.

HistoryOrdersPageResponse.title: HistoryOrdersPageResponse
HistoryOrdersPageResponse.description: At most 50 orders, newest first; `next` is the `after` of the following page, null on the last one.

LinkCodeResponse.title: LinkCodeResponse
LinkCodeResponse.description:
The code the user sends to the bot from the chat to link, until when it is valid, and the link that sends it
in one tap; no link while the bot is not active (R1.8.1).

LinkedChatResponse.title: LinkedChatResponse
LinkedChatResponse.description: Whether the tenant has a linked chat, and which one as Telegram numbers it, for the dashboard to show it.

ModelParameterResponse.title: ModelParameterResponse
ModelParameterResponse.description: A range has minimum and maximum, a choice its values; the default is always there.

OperationResponse.title: OperationResponse
OperationResponse.description:
A row of the ledger (ADR 0063, ADR 0074): amounts as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0047).

An execution has side, size and price; a funding payment has the amount paid (positive when received). `flow` is
the name of the flow of the row, null when it belongs to no flow (ADR 0080).

OperationsPageResponse.title: OperationsPageResponse
OperationsPageResponse.description: At most 50 rows, newest first; `next` is the `after` of the following page, null on the last one.

OperationsTotalsResponse.title: OperationsTotalsResponse
OperationsTotalsResponse.description: The totals of every row of the filter, not only of the page (ADR 0080).

OrderExecutionResponse.title: OrderExecutionResponse
OrderExecutionResponse.description: An execution of an order: price, quantity and fee as text without trailing zeros (ADR 0018).

OrderOutcomeResponse.title: OrderOutcomeResponse
OrderOutcomeResponse.description: The outcome of an order as the exchange gave it: the same body from worker and API (ADR 0023).

ProviderKeyResponse.title: ProviderKeyResponse
ProviderKeyResponse.description: A registered key as its owner reads it: the provider and when it was saved, never the key (R1.4.1, ADR 0130).

StopOutcomeResponse.title: StopOutcomeResponse
StopOutcomeResponse.description: The flow stopped and the positions the exchange did not close, each with its reason (R1.1.5).

StrategyBody-Input.title: StrategyBody
StrategyBody-Input.description:
What a flow does, without account, capital, assets, keys or cycles (R2.5.2).

A missing model or limit arrives empty, so the domain answers with the reason.

StrategyBody-Output.title: StrategyBody
StrategyBody-Output.description:
What a flow does, without account, capital, assets, keys or cycles (R2.5.2).

A missing model or limit arrives empty, so the domain answers with the reason.

StrategyDocument-Input.title: StrategyDocument
StrategyDocument-Input.description: The strategy file: its format and version, so a file of another kind or of a later version is recognized.

StrategyDocument-Output.title: StrategyDocument
StrategyDocument-Output.description: The strategy file: its format and version, so a file of another kind or of a later version is recognized.

VerificationRunResponse.title: VerificationRunResponse
VerificationRunResponse.description: A run of the procedure with the outcome of each step: the same body from worker and API (ADR 0024).

VersionResponse.title: VersionResponse
VersionResponse.description: One configuration version of a flow in the list: its number and when it was saved (R2.3.5).
